title: workbench evolution persona roster (.workbench/evolution/personas.json)
description: Project-configurable persona panel for /workbench:evolve summits. Flat object: scalar knobs plus one 'personas' array of flat objects (string values only) — the shape scripts/evolve.sh's dependency-free parser understands. Exactly one persona must have role 'critic'.

cadence_hours.description: A summit is due when more than this many hours have passed since the last one, regardless of backlog depth (keeps the retrospective mandate from starving).

queue_low_water.description: A summit is due when the unblocked backlog (for the configured track) drops below this count — the 'keep 2-3 tasks queued' threshold.

retro_slice.description: How many not-yet-audited verified/shipped tasks each summit re-examines (oldest-by-ID first).

track.description: Optional **Track:** scope for trigger counting, retrospective candidates, and synthesized tasks. Empty = all tracks.

prompt.description: The persona's role description, used verbatim as its agent-panel prompt.
